summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload under trusted @ornikar scope
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed code (identifiers like _0x488df8, _0x52943e, string-array rotator) that detects platform/arch, downloads the Bun runtime ZIP from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it against a locally shipped ~727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle math_init.js (file header `// @bun @bun-cjs` followed by a scrambled constants table). The package is published as an ESLint TypeScript/NestJS config within the @ornikar scope and declares peer @ornikar/eslint-config* dependencies, but downloading a second language runtime at install time and executing an opaque Bun-compiled payload has no relationship to ESLint configuration. The payload runs with the installer's privileges on `npm install`, and its Bun-compiled form is not scannable by Node-based tooling. The behavior is not present in the genuine @ornikar/eslint-configs repository referenced in package.json.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
